stem:
[Image: A shaded rectangle that is 6 cm by 16 cm. Part of the rectangle is unshaded. The unshaded part of the rectangle forms a right triangle on the left that is 6 centimeters by 8 centimeters.]

In the figure above, what is the area of the shaded region in cm^2?
figure_description: A rectangle with a height of 6 cm and a total length of 16 cm along the top, both labeled with dimension arrows. An unshaded right triangle occupies the bottom-left portion of the rectangle; its vertical leg is the left side of the rectangle (6 cm) and its horizontal leg along the bottom has a length of 8 cm labeled with a dimension arrow. The remainder of the rectangle is shaded solid black.
